newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Komercni to publish results Friday.
newsitem.headline: Czech Komercni to publish results Friday.

text.p: Komercni Banka a.s., the Czech Republic's largest commercial bank, on Wednesday said it would release its nine-month results on Friday.
"Results of Komercni Banka for the third quarter of this year will be made public on the first of November," Kamil Ziegler, the bank's financial department director, said in a statement.
Earlier on Wednesday, analysts said Komercni's results for nine-months, according to their own estimates, would be lower than expected.
The bank would not comment on the analyst estimates, and said it had not revealed any of its nine-month results.
